flags.message: The provisioned petition.txt is truncated (documents.json: truncated=true) at the start of the appendix, so the Fourth Circuit opinion under review was not readable from the record; the petition body itself is complete. Separately, the docket carries three post-BIO filings (reply Sept 9, respondents' supplemental brief Sept 14, petitioner's response Sept 15) that were not provisioned; the Sept 14 brief discloses that the bankruptcy court dismissed the adversary complaint without prejudice on Sept 10, 2026, a vehicle development I fetched from supremecourt.gov and weighed in the forecast.
